player_prompt.intro:
I bɛna tɛmɛ {N} kɛcɔgɔw lafilila.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, i bɛna bakɛ [accept] ka tɛmɛ *sisan* kɛcɔgɔ, wa [continue] ka tɔgɔ a ma kɛnɛ kɔnɔntɔ.
Ni i tɛmɛna kɛcɔgɔ tɛ, i bɛna tɛmɛ kɛcɔgɔ laban.
I bɛna sɔrɔ (ka bɔ 1) **kɛrɛfɛ** ni kɛcɔgɔ i tɛmɛna kɛnɛ kɛcɔgɔw bɛɛ lafilila.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O waleya ka kan ka kɛ [accept] walima [continue] ye.

outcome.summary: I tɛmɛna kɛcɔgɔ {value} kɔnɔ {draw_num}/{N}. Kɛcɔgɔ kɛnɛma bɛ {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: O ye sugandili ɲumanba de ye!
outcome.not_max: A ka ca a la o tɛ.
